title: Fix test timeout in plugin-editor from Monaco Editor initialization
body:
The `@object-ui/plugin-editor` test suite was timing out during the `beforeAll` hook that imports Monaco Editor. The default Vitest hook timeout (10s) is insufficient for Monaco's initialization in the test environment.

## Changes

- Increased `beforeAll` hook timeout to 30s in `packages/plugin-editor/src/index.test.ts`

```typescript
beforeAll(async () => {
  await import('./index');
}, 30000); // 30 second timeout for Monaco Editor initialization
```

Monaco Editor is lazy-loaded in the component via `React.lazy()` but still loads synchronously when imported during test setup. The timeout accommodates this heavy dependency initialization.
